image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of three baby bibs arranged in a slightly overlapping pile on a white surface. The top bib is dark blue with a subtle white pattern and pink trim/accents. The bottom left bib is solid royal blue with a light green inner lining visible at the neck hole. The bottom right bib is bright pink with a textured dot pattern. All bibs feature a central neck opening and appear to be made of soft fabric.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'seamless' transition between the green lining and blue fabric on the left bib. Real sewing usually shows a fold or stitch line. Also, check if the patterns on the blue bibs distort logically around the curves.
